where I will deck the imperial buffet with sumptuous vessels of gold and silver. For you, though, Majesty, there will be goblets of gleaming Venetian glass beckoning with delight. In them the wine grows stronger but never intoxicates. The goblet’s virtue, of course, it too often invoked; but Your Majesty's moderation will save you from that.

@@U04336@@
These honors as bestowed are sacred and valid; and yet, for confirmation, we will put it to paper. And here I see coming just the man to do that.

@@U04337@@
(Enter the CHANCELLOR-ARCHBISHOP)

@@U04339@@
Once the arch entrusts itself to the keystone, it is forever secure. You see here four princes, my Lord Chancellor— also our Archbishop— with whom I have just discussed the governance of my house and court. Let us now consider the Empire as a whole, for it is on you five that I now rest its full weight and authority. You will outshine all others in landed possessions, and therefore I enlarge your present territories from the holdings of those rebels who supported our enemy. But not only are splendid estates and domains now yours, yours is also the right to extend them further by way of succession, purchase, and exchange, as opportunity affords. In addition, yours in perpetuity is the exercise of those feudal privileges which accrue to you

@@U04334@@
我将在那里用华丽的金银器皿装饰皇家自助餐。不过，陛下，闪闪发光的威尼斯玻璃高脚杯将会令人愉悦地向您招手。在它们里面，酒会变得更烈，但永远不会让人陶醉。当然，人们经常提到高脚杯的美德。但陛下的节制将使您免遭这种情况。

@@U04336@@
这些荣誉是神圣而有效的；然而，为了确认，我们将把它写在纸上。在这里，我看到了能做到这一点的人。

@@U04337@@
（大主教上）

@@U04339@@
一旦拱门将自己托付给拱心石，它就永远安全。你在这里看到了四位王子，我的大法官——也是我们的大主教——我刚刚与他们讨论了我的宫廷和宫廷的治理问题。现在让我们考虑整个帝国，因为我现在把全部的分量和权威都放在你们五个身上了。你们将在土地占有方面胜过所有其他人，因此我从那些支持我们敌人的叛乱分子手中扩大了你们目前的领土。现在，您不仅拥有辉煌的地产和领地，而且还有权在机会允许的情况下通过继承、购买和交换的方式进一步扩展它们。此外，您永久享有行使您所获得的封建特权的权利
